principle.en: A physical product that must be built, shipped and supported. Margin depends on volume, and volume depends on suppliers. The questions follow SeriesOps' note on hardware gross margin: the deck must show the margin at 1,000, 10,000 and 100,000 units, the bill of materials, and the minimum order quantities. The economics block counts double.
principle.fr: Un produit physique qu'il faut fabriquer, expédier et supporter. La marge dépend du volume, et le volume dépend des fournisseurs. Les questions suivent la note de SeriesOps sur la marge brute hardware : le deck doit montrer la marge à 1 000, 10 000 et 100 000 unités, la nomenclature, et les quantités minimales de commande. Le bloc économie compte double.

sources.title: SeriesOps, Gross Margin for Hardware Startups: What's Actually Good at Seed Stage?
Burkland, How Investors Evaluate Series A Startups in 2026

questions.found_if: A margin per unit at each of the three volumes, with the cost lines that change between them.
questions.note: A single margin figure without volume = partial. Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.
